moments.title: Extreme Heat Warning for England
moments.blurb: An amber 'extreme heat' warning has been issued for large parts of England for Thursday, August 13, with temperatures potentially reaching 38C, and amber heat health alerts are in place across England until Friday.

angles.name: Heatwave Prep
angles.copy: Another heatwave is on the way for parts of England this Thursday, with temperatures set to hit 38C. Stay hydrated and check on vulnerable neighbours.

angles.name: Travel Disruption
angles.copy: Amber heat warnings mean potential travel delays and power cuts this week across England. Plan your journeys now.

moments.title: Wales Braces for Heatwave Amid Wildfires
moments.blurb: A heatwave is forecast for much of Wales with temperatures up to 28C, while firefighters are battling reignited wildfires in Llanwonno, Ferndale, and a large blaze near Llangynidr reservoir.

angles.name: Stay Safe in the Heat
angles.copy: Warm weather for Wales this week, with highs of 28C. Remember to stay safe in the sun and be mindful of fire risks with ongoing wildfires in the south.

angles.name: Fire Alert
angles.copy: Wildfires have reignited in Llanwonno and continue near Llangynidr. Huge thanks to our fire services working tirelessly. Residents, please stay vigilant.

moments.title: New Forest Wildfire Continues
moments.blurb: Firefighters are entering a third day of tackling a significant wildfire in the New Forest, Hampshire, which spread from a vehicle fire.

angles.name: New Forest Blaze
angles.copy: Our thoughts are with the firefighters battling the New Forest blaze for a third day. Stay safe and avoid the area if possible.

moments.title: UK Singles Chart Update
moments.blurb: The Official Singles Chart Update for August 9-15, 2026, is out, highlighting the UK's biggest songs.

angles.name: Chart Toppers
angles.copy: What's topping your playlist this week? The Official Singles Chart Update for Aug 9-15 is in! Is your favourite song making waves?

angles.name: Olivia Dean & Sam Fender Reign
angles.copy: Olivia Dean's 'Man I Need' is still huge this year, and her collab with Sam Fender, 'Rein Me In', is the longest-running No. 1 by a British act ever! Legends.

moments.title: The Weeknd at Wembley Stadium
moments.blurb: The Weeknd's 'After Hours Til Dawn Tour' continues its run at Wembley Stadium in London from August 11 to August 15.

angles.name: Wembley Weekend
angles.copy: The Weeknd is bringing the 'After Hours Til Dawn Tour' to Wembley Stadium all this week! Who's heading to see Abel Tesfaye live?

angles.name: Stadium Vibes
angles.copy: Wembley is buzzing with The Weeknd this week! Expect incredible visuals and all the hits from his 'After Hours Til Dawn' show.

moments.title: Edinburgh Fringe Festival in Full Swing
moments.blurb: The Edinburgh Fringe Festival is well underway, with over 2000 shows taking place over three and a half weeks.

angles.name: Fringe Fun
angles.copy: Edinburgh is alive with the sound of laughter, music, and drama! The Fringe Festival is in full swing with thousands of shows to catch.

angles.name: Festival City
angles.copy: Visiting Edinburgh for the Fringe? So much to see and do! What's the best show you've caught so far?

moments.title: Exeter Road Closures for Gas Works
moments.blurb: Key Exeter routes including Matford Lane, Topsham Road, and Matford Avenue are closed for gas works from August 10 until September 4.

angles.name: Exeter Traffic Alert
angles.copy: Heads up Exeter drivers! Matford Lane, Topsham Road, and Matford Avenue are affected by gas works until early September. Expect diversions and allow extra time.

angles.name: Planning Your Journey
angles.copy: Navigating Exeter this week? Remember the road closures around Matford for essential gas works. Check diversion routes before you travel!

moments.title: Exeter Cathedral Free Open Days
moments.blurb: Exeter Cathedral is offering free entry on Friday 13th and Saturday 14th August as part of a National Lottery Heritage Fund project, inviting public feedback on planned improvements.

angles.name: Explore Exeter Cathedral
angles.copy: Fancy a free visit to Exeter Cathedral? This Friday and Saturday, explore its history and share your thoughts on future improvements. Don't miss out!

angles.name: Heritage Project
angles.copy: Be part of Exeter Cathedral's future! Free entry this Friday & Saturday to see proposed improvements and give your feedback.

moments.title: Happy 50th, Ben Gibbard!
moments.blurb: Ben Gibbard, frontman of Death Cab for Cutie and The Postal Service, turns 50 today, August 11.

angles.name: Indie Icon
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 50th birthday to Ben Gibbard of Death Cab for Cutie and The Postal Service! What's your favourite track?

angles.name: Death Cab & Postal Service
angles.copy: Celebrating Ben Gibbard's 50th today! From 'Transatlanticism' to 'Give Up', his music has defined a generation.

moments.title: Happy 71st, Joe Jackson!
moments.blurb: English singer-songwriter Joe Jackson, known for hits like 'Is She Really Going Out with Him?', celebrates his 71st birthday today, August 11.

angles.name: New Wave Legend
angles.copy: Happy 71st birthday to the brilliant Joe Jackson! Still 'Steppin' Out' with iconic tunes. What's your top Joe Jackson track?

angles.name: Timeless Talent
angles.copy: Celebrating Joe Jackson's 71st today! His sharp songwriting and genre-bending sound are still as fresh as ever.

moments.title: Happy 83rd, Kenny Gamble!
moments.blurb: Legendary songwriter and producer Kenny Gamble, half of the iconic Gamble and Huff duo behind the 'Sound of Philadelphia', turns 83 today, August 11.

angles.name: Philly Soul Master
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 83rd birthday to the incredible Kenny Gamble! A true architect of soul music.

angles.name: Music Maestro
angles.copy: From 'If You Don't Know Me By Now' to 'Me and Mrs. Jones', Kenny Gamble's influence on music is immense. Happy Birthday!

moments.title: Happy 63rd, Sir Mix-A-Lot!
moments.blurb: Rapper and producer Sir Mix-A-Lot, best known for his 1992 hit 'Baby Got Back', celebrates his 63rd birthday tomorrow, August 12.

angles.name: Hip-Hop Icon
angles.copy: Tomorrow, we're celebrating Sir Mix-A-Lot's 63rd birthday! Get ready to 'put a sista in a Benz'.

moments.title: Happy 65th, Roy Hay!
moments.blurb: Roy Hay, guitarist and keyboardist for the iconic 80s band Culture Club, turns 65 tomorrow, August 12.

angles.name: Culture Club Star
angles.copy: Tomorrow, let's wish a very happy 65th birthday to Roy Hay of Culture Club! What's your favourite Culture Club classic?

moments.title: Happy 42nd, James Morrison!
moments.blurb: British singer-songwriter James Morrison, known for hits like 'You Give Me Something', celebrates his 42nd birthday tomorrow, August 12.

angles.name: Soulful Singer
angles.copy: Tomorrow is James Morrison's 42nd birthday! Get ready to feel 'Wonderful World' vibes.

moments.title: Happy 78th, Robert Plant!
moments.blurb: Led Zeppelin frontman Robert Plant will celebrate his 78th birthday on August 20.

angles.name: Rock God
angles.copy: Next week, we'll be wishing a very happy 78th birthday to the legendary voice of Led Zeppelin, Robert Plant! What's your favourite Zep track?

moments.title: Happy 47th, Kelis!
moments.blurb: American singer-songwriter Kelis, known for hits like 'Milkshake' and 'Caught Out There', will celebrate her 47th birthday on August 21.

angles.name: R&B Queen
angles.copy: Next Friday, it's Kelis's 47th birthday! Get ready to bring all the boys to the yard.

moments.title: Exeter Chiefs Takeover Complete
moments.blurb: The £19.6 million takeover deal for Exeter Chiefs by a subsidiary of US-based Cannae Holdings has been completed.

angles.name: Chiefs New Era
angles.copy: Big news for Exeter Chiefs! The £19.6 million takeover is complete, ushering in a new era for the club.

moments.title: Welsh Language 'Crisis' in Communities
moments.blurb: The Welsh language is reportedly facing a 'crisis' as it dwindles in traditional communities across Wales, despite an increase in speakers in cities like Cardiff.

angles.name: Preserving Welsh
angles.copy: A new report highlights the 'crisis' facing the Welsh language in some communities. How important is it to you to preserve Cymraeg?
